mostWorthwhile.text: Aerobic ATP renewal was most worthwhile: the planned picture distinguishes fuel oxidation from oxygen’s role and connects hydrogen-ion flow through ATP synthase to ATP production.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying amino acids at the cell interior was the least satisfying passage: the ribosomes and messages were already shown there, but the required energy-supply pairing emerged only through compatibility feedback.

surprise.text: I expected protein production to start at the cell interior; the feedback instead offered ATP-related partners, and the result showed ATP supporting amino-acid preparation.

arbitrary.text: Combining amino acids directly with aerobic ATP renewal felt somewhat arbitrary as an interface action, although the final inset gives the energy connection a purpose.

continue.text: I would continue: the constructions connect membrane transport and ATP use in useful ways, and I would be curious to see how later structures build on them.
